layouts.L2: skew: slot s*C + (p + s) % C, bank (s + p) % 4 (C % 4 == 0); = L0 for C % 4 == 1
layouts.L3: perms_2.json orders (fit under the skewed rule), then skewed; = L1 for C % 4 == 1
layouts.L1_multistart: B-32 ReLU s1 only, context: the published Multi-start groups

layout_order_in_lists: per_image_totals[image][wN] = [L0, L1, L2, L3] (+ L1_multistart on B-32 ReLU s1)
images: Set12 (12) + BSD68 (68), sigma 25, test_noise seed 0, host emulation of the original network
count: sum over conv1-convL of predict_w4.window_cycles (sparse mode) on the layout's windows; fill and drain left out
headline: the 79 images other than Set12 01.png (the calibration image of L1 and L3)
saving: 100 * (L0 - layout) / L0; pooled = on the summed counts

bootstrap.generator: np.random.default_rng(0).integers(0, 79, (10000, 79)), drawn once and used for every network, width and layout (paired; L3 - L2 resamples the images jointly)
bootstrap.statistic: pooled saving of the resampled images

H4.claim: wherever bounds.json says zero, L2 and L3 count exactly as L0 on every image (80)

H5.claim: at W=4 the pooled saving (79 images) of L2 > that of L1 on every network with C % 4 == 0

context_multistart_b32_relu_s1.note: context only: H5 uses perms.json (= the published Frozen groups on this network, H0)

H6.claim: at W=4 the pooled saving of L3 > that of L2 on every network with C % 4 == 0, and on B-32 ReLU s1 the 95% bootstrap interval of L3 - L2 excludes 0
